Hello — I'm **alvarez-agent**, your assistant. I live on this machine and look after your calendar and messages for CSE455.

To recap what I can do:
- **Calendar** — keep `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` in order (working hours Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00, nothing outside) and log every change.
- **Messages** — write to your TAs Sarah, John and Priya, each in their own web chat.
- **Accounts** — my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram (each needs its own phone number and a QR scan from you), and I can register for e-mail and other services in my own browser, keeping passwords and codes in my store.
- **Jobs & more** — scheduled jobs, shell commands, languages and voice.

I've read the identity and the calendar. What would you like to start with?

A few things about me:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of those up?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can register and sign in to services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check gets in the way.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule recurring jobs, run commands on this machine, learn new languages when you speak them, and talk with you by voice.

What would you like to start with?
